recommendation_scope: Controlled synthetic lab infrastructure apply only, conditional on explicit owner approval of all 69 resources including budget and email subscription; no pipeline execution included.

cloudwatch_custom_metrics_price.description: $0.30 per metric-month for the first 10,000 metrics - South America (Sao Paulo)

iam_review.runner_trust: Exact current data-dev SSO role only; no other SSO principals configured.
iam_review.allowed_actions: Explicit service actions with scoped buckets/prefixes, catalog resources, functions/jobs and SNS topic.
iam_review.wildcard_resource_exception: cloudwatch:PutMetricData Resource * constrained to namespace Glue.
iam_review.glue_logging_scope: /aws-glue/* within this account/region; broader than this lab prefix.
iam_review.effective_policy_limit: Plan/source inspection and earlier simulations do not prove runtime access or actual alert delivery.

cost_estimate.usage_limitations: Actual job startup/install/runtime, billed scans, metrics, request counts and transfers unmeasured. Include actual S3/log/SNS/EventBridge usage; no free tier, credits, taxes or FX assumed. Airflow can retry and increase cost.
cost_estimate.budget_monitoring_service_fee: No monitoring/notification charge for budgets without actions/reports per official pricing.

persistent_costs: Three CloudWatch alarms while retained, prorated by time.
S3 data/results/state versions and incomplete uploads until lifecycle or authorised cleanup; logs until expiry/deletion.
Glue custom metrics based on actual activity; logs, SNS/EventBridge and S3 requests/transfers according to use.
State bucket and remote dev state deliberately remain after lab teardown.

architecture.dbt_athena_iceberg: Silver/Gold tables created by dbt at execution time, not by this Terraform plan.

residual_risks: IAM/layer/package compatibility is checked statically; Glue dependency install, Ion SerDe, Athena Iceberg MERGE and actual alert delivery remain unexecuted.
SNS e-mail must be confirmed after any authorised apply before alert validation.
The USD 5 budget covers the entire account, includes unrelated costs and does not stop spending.

Temporary synthetic-lab security exceptions remain: SSE-S3, no cross-region replication/object-access audit, no Lambda VPC/code signing, SNS without CMK; Glue Catalog metadata encryption is currently disabled.
Two versioned lock objects and delete markers remain from normal planning locks; active lock is absent.
Bootstrap state/backup share one local disk.

sequence: Preserve sanitised run reports/manifests/query outputs/logs and state snapshots before deletion.
Read-only teardown helper dry-run: verify both exact dev bucket names/tags and exact Silver/Gold database names; state bucket excluded.
Obtain separate cleanup approval; remove all versions/delete markers in the two lab buckets and dbt-owned tables; inspect incomplete multipart uploads and running work.
Generate/review dev destroy plan under separate authorisation, then obtain destroy approval.
Verify only shared state resources remain; preserve bootstrap local state and remote dev state/history.
teardown_review.helper_limit: Incomplete uploads and unexpected resources require separate inventory/approved cleanup; no automatic state bucket deletion.
